title: Leg raises superset
summary: Clip of a lying leg raise superset for abs. The audio is an unrelated Gravity Falls review playing in the background, so this note relies on the title, tags and description: direct ab isolation work is needed for maximum ab hypertrophy.

claims.claim: For maximum ab hypertrophy, compound movements alone aren't enough; you need direct ab isolation work such as leg raises, even if it's boring.
